name: diagram-explainer
description: Write an explainer as one HTML file with a figure drawn in every section, built from JSON and checked before you share it

interface.longDescription: Writes an explainer of a system, a piece of research, or a setup as one HTML file you can hand to anyone. You agree on the outline first. The document shows one section at a time from a contents list, splits several topics into pages with header tabs, has a slide-in contents list on phones, and prints to PDF. Every section has a figure drawn in the page: boxes and arrows in HTML, charts for times, amounts, numbers, and periods, or a step ladder. The content is kept as JSON, so it can be rebuilt after any change. Before you see it, the document is checked for network use, structure, captions, and its text, with full wording rules for Japanese. It opens offline and installs nothing.
defaultPrompt: Write an explainer with figures on how OAuth sign-in works
